about_the_game:
There are places no one should enter. Objects no one should touch. And secrets best left alone. You do it all — professionally.

You are an agent of Secret Seekers, an interdimensional organization that retrieves strange and often disturbing artifacts. Explore abandoned sites scattered across alternate realities. Discover their hidden stories, absorb their atmosphere, and sense the danger lurking just beyond perception.

Your greatest enemy won’t be monsters, ghosts, or supernatural forces. It will be time. Can you outrun it? Prove it.

Key Features

Worlds You Were Never Meant to Enter
Explore a haunted village, a forgotten temple, an abandoned lab, and other places left behind long ago — for reasons best left unspoken. Each location hides a story waiting to be discovered or lost forever.

Search Objects. Uncover Truths
Your main goal is to locate specific items assigned by the agency. Some are hidden. Others reveal fragments of the world’s untold past — things that happened, but no one wants to talk about.

Time Won’t Kill You. But It Won’t Let You Win
Each mission changes the rules. Time is always against you, and when it runs out, you lose everything — except what you've learned. Unlock tools, abilities, and knowledge that improve your chances in future runs.

Your Gear. Your Strategy. Your Risk

Select the right tools for each mission — flashlights, night vision, drones, compasses, and more. What you choose can determine success or failure. Experiment, upgrade, and build your own style of exploration.

The Museum That Remembers Everything
Discover your personal operations center – a mysterious museum where all recovered artifacts are stored. It’s your silent gallery of failures and triumphs. Watch as the space evolves with your progress, and empty display cases slowly fill with the objects you've brought back…

Immersive and Unnerving Atmosphere
Secret Seeker doesn’t rely on loud scares. It builds tension through whispers. Ambient audio, realistic visuals, and slow-burning suspense create an experience that leaves room for personal interpretation — and quiet dread.

Challenging but Fair
No hints. No hand-holding. Secret Seeker respects your time — and your mistakes. You’ll fail, often. But each attempt reveals more about the world, yourself, and the shadows that wait in silence.

Relax Mode

For those who prefer to explore at their own pace, Secret Seeker includes a dedicated Relax Mode. Time is no longer a threat — you're free to explore, search, and absorb the world’s secrets without pressure. All tools and upgrades unlocked in roguelike mode are available here.

Shadow Leaderboards

Compete quietly through global leaderboards. Compare your results by level or full runs — based on time, efficiency, and the number of items found. It's a subtle but satisfying challenge for players who want to prove their mastery.

Content Warning

This game contains psychological tension, horror themes, a sense of unease, and suggestive depictions of supernatural events and violence. Player discretion is advised.

name: Secret Seeker

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Explore abandoned locations across dimensions no one dares to enter. Secret Seeker is a dark first-person game that combines hidden object mechanics with roguelike elements, where time is your greatest enemy. Steal forbidden artifacts and uncover their disturbing secrets.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
